nodes.label: C
nodes.title:
John the Baptist is the prophet.
The exhortations about repentance of John the Baptist surround the pair of the words of the Bible (Isaiah 40:3) and its fulfillment. The center is description about John the Baptist. This description (clothings) indicates that he is like a traditional prophet in Old Testament
